answer: Under Sybil pressure, collateral lockup scales quadratically: each forged identity raises slashing exposure as k², so an n-node cluster commits n²·C capital while extractable value grows linearly at n·V; when C>V/2, marginal attack cost dominates. Quadratic erosion sinks liquidity like a receding tide, rendering the relic assumption of cheap identity obsolete—each hostile meadow of pseudonyms burns quadratically more stake, sustaining consensus security.
